observation.diagnosis: beveling a rim edge loop adjacent to an n-gon cap creates one valence-3 vertex per cap-boundary vertex (16 top + 16 bottom = 32) -- the n-gon lacks the edge flow to absorb the bevel cleanly. This same issue likely affected the original bottle/flashlight rim bevels too, just never isolated and checked at the time.

reason: rebuild with end_fill_type=TRIFAN instead of the default NGON -- rim vertices of a trifan cap stay valence-4 (2 fan neighbors + 1 to center + 1 down the side wall), confining the necessary pole to the flat cap's center where it causes no visible curvature artifact -- standard professional practice for flat end caps
